name: How can I prevent future sewage backups?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future sewage backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing sewage backups involves proactive measures. Avoid flushing anything other than toilet paper and human waste. Be mindful of what goes down your drains, especially grease and food scraps. Consider installing a backwater valve on your sewer line, which prevents municipal sewer water from flowing back into your home. Regular professional plumbing inspections can identify potential issues like tree root intrusion or deteriorating pipes before they cause a major backup, allowing for timely repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent backups by not flushing non-biodegradables or pouring grease, considering a backwater valve, and scheduling regular plumbing inspections.
